results.description: Verify initial seed data integrity and user profile initialization
Verify calculation of Total Income (₹ 35,000) and Total Expense (₹ 16,550)
Verify Savings formula: Savings = Total Income - Total Expense and Balance matches (₹ 18,450)
Verify Expense by Category percentage distribution matches template design
Verify adding a new expense transaction increments Total Expense and adjusts Balance
Verify adding a new income transaction increments Total Income and increases Balance
Verify editing a transaction updates amount, note, and recalculates ledger totals
Verify deleting a transaction removes it from list and restores financial balances
Verify filtering transactions by Category returns only matching items
Verify filtering transactions by Type (expense vs income) returns strictly typed entries
Verify keyword search finds transactions matching description or merchant name
Verify Budget calculation computes accurate spent amount and percentage against limit
Verify Budget alert is triggered when category spending reaches or exceeds 80%
Verify Critical Budget alert is raised when category spending exceeds 100%
Verify creating a custom category with custom color and icon
Verify FR-22 safeguard: deleting a custom category reassigns its transactions to Others
Verify creation of a new savings goal with target amount, target date, and initial progress
Verify depositing savings into a goal increases saved amount and recalculates progress
Verify FR-28: reaching 100% target marks goal completed and triggers celebration alert
Verify FR-31: persistence in localStorage, backup export integrity, and factory reset
